orchestrator.role: Classifies every incoming user task into domain, complexity, and latency budget, routes to designated Tier pair, and dispatches to agent CLI.

tier_1_frontier.name: Tier 1: Frontier Architecture & Reasoning
tier_1_frontier.description: Deep conceptual analysis, system architecture, and multi-step reasoning

tier_2_coding.name: Tier 2: High-End Code Synthesis & Refactoring
tier_2_coding.description: Full-stack code generation, AST transformations, and test execution

tier_3_deep_thinking.name: Tier 3: Mathematical Proof & Extended Thinking
tier_3_deep_thinking.description: Deep thinking chain-of-thought, symbolic proof, and algorithmic verification

tier_4_multimodal.name: Tier 4: Multimodal Vision & Diagram Analysis
tier_4_multimodal.description: UI layout inspection, document OCR, architectural diagrams, and image synthesis

tier_5_fast_throughput.name: Tier 5: Ultra-Fast Throughput & Telemetry
tier_5_fast_throughput.description: Low-latency classification, quick telemetry summarization, and rapid tool loops

tier_6_local_fallback.name: Tier 6: Local Host / Offline Fallback
tier_6_local_fallback.description: Zero-egress offline inference when external gateways are unavailable
